description: Search the encyclopedias for articles to read on an e-reader: Wikipedia, the Simple English Wikipedia (short, plain articles), Wikivoyage (travel guides), and old reference works in the public domain — the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica, the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the Dictionary of National Biography (1885–1900) and The New International Encyclopædia (1905). Returns each article's source and title.
name: search_encyclopedia
title: Search the encyclopedias
